> **Text and stencil correctness** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects native text-resource cleanup and clipped render-pass stencil checks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Native text cleanup and stencil checks corrected** — Fixes use-after-free during malformed Slug deserialization and checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379), [#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))
